notes: Canon-tracking power curve for all of Book 1. Only tiers 0 and 1 are reachable in Milestone 1. Values are absolute for the tier, not deltas. damage multiplies weapon damage, speed multiplies walking speed, draw multiplies how fast the bow draws (higher is faster).

tiers.name: Starving Mortal
tiers.canon: Winter has whittled her down to ribs and stubbornness. One bow, three arrows, one knife.

tiers.name: Fed Huntress
tiers.canon: Venison on the table for the first time in weeks. A small mercy, but she is steadier for it.

tiers.name: Guest of the Spring Court
unlocks: Better bows from the manor armoury
tiers.canon: Fed, bathed and rested at the manor, and given the run of the grounds.

tiers.name: Suriel Hunter
tiers.canon: Traps the Suriel and survives the naga, with Tamlin's help.

tiers.name: Fire Night
tiers.canon: Calanmai. Confidence, defiance, and a first brush with the High Lord of the Night Court.

tiers.name: Prisoner Under the Mountain
tiers.canon: Beaten, starved and caged. A deliberate dip: her power drops when canon says it should.

tiers.name: Trial Survivor
tiers.canon: Outwits the worm in the mud and survives the trials.

tiers.name: Made Fae
tiers.canon: Remade by the seven High Lords. Immortal strength, speed and senses. The gap from Tier 0 should be obvious.
